description: Design quality rules injected into PM step to ensure production-grade UX in generated systems. Each rule category maps to concrete acceptance criteria the PM must emit.

crud_completeness.rule: Every entity/resource MUST have Create, Read (list + detail), Update, and DELETE operations.
crud_completeness.delete_requires: Confirmation dialog or prompt before destructive action.
crud_completeness.list_requires: Table or card view with at least: name/title column, created date, action buttons (edit, delete).
crud_completeness.detail_requires: Read-only detail view or inline edit form for each entity.

operation_feedback.rule: Every write operation (create, update, delete) MUST show success or failure feedback to the user.
operation_feedback.mechanism: Toast notification, inline status message, or modal confirmation.
operation_feedback.timing: Feedback must appear within 2 seconds of operation completion.

empty_states.rule: Every list or collection view MUST have an empty state when no data exists.
requirements: Descriptive text explaining what will appear here
Primary action button to create the first item (e.g. 'Add your first customer')

form_validation.rule: All forms MUST validate required fields before submission.
form_validation.inline_errors: Show field-level error messages next to invalid fields on submit.
form_validation.submit_button: Show loading/disabled state during submission to prevent double-submit.

loading_states.rule: Every async data fetch MUST show a loading indicator while pending.
loading_states.mechanism: Spinner, skeleton, or 'Loading...' text in the data container.

error_handling.network_error: Show error message with a retry option when API calls fail.
error_handling.not_found: Show 'not found' message with navigation back to list.
error_handling.form_error: Show server-side validation errors inline without losing form data.

navigation.rule: Multi-module apps MUST have persistent navigation (sidebar or top nav) between all modules.
navigation.active_state: Current module must be visually highlighted in navigation.
navigation.breadcrumbs: Detail/edit views should show path back to list view.

module_coverage.rule: The frontend MUST implement ALL modules defined in the spec, not just the first one.
module_coverage.each_module_requires: Its own list view, create/edit form, and detail view at minimum.
